## pb-ssh-bruteforce (N8N-4.2)
**Trigger:** called by lib-alert-queue-drain through Execute Workflow (waited for; by recv-wazuh-alert, not waited for, only when the queue is unavailable), when lib-route-alert routes the alert here: rows `ssh-bruteforce` (5712, 5763) and `suspicious-login-40112` (40112) of lib-config `routing`.
**Inputs:** `{alert: <raw Wazuh alert>, config: <lib-config>, recv_execution_id, route: <lib-route-alert route>}`, as pb-generic.
**Actions taken:** pb-generic's chain, same libs, same order, same repair path on `duplicate` (custom field and metrics `playbook` = pb-ssh-bruteforce; severity and enrichment start reach lib-enrich-observable as in pb-generic, D-N7, D-N8): lib-normalize-wazuh-alert -> lib-extract-observables -> lib-misp-warninglist -> lib-thehive-upsert-alert -> created (or repaired) only: lib-enrich-observable -> **lib-ssh-correlate** (read-only, one bounded TheHive query: alerts from the same `data.srcip` within lib-config `ssh_correlation.window_s` (3600 s) of the event time, templates ssh-bruteforce / suspicious-login; On Error = continue, a failure is `failed (<class>)`, never parked) -> one TheHive alert at a time (Loop Over Items; TheHive retry pattern N8N-6.2, the attempt number carried by the item; after a call fails all its retries the rest are not attempted; never parks): this alert gets the tag `ssh-campaign:<srcip>`; a brute-force alert with a related 40112 in the window escalates itself; a 40112 escalates every related `ssh-bruteforce` alert. Escalation = tag `ssh:login-after-bruteforce`, severity raised to `escalate_severity` (4) if lower (never lowered, D12), one comment starting `[asox-n8n escalation] wazuh-alert-id=<40112 id>` (written only if n8n's account has none with that first line), and the related alert's asox-metrics `severity` through lib-metrics-upsert (mode update; this alert's own goes into its writeback's document) -> lib-thehive-writeback (pb-generic's sections, then "Related (same source within 1 h)": the total and up to `max_listed` (10) alerts with rule and time, the tag, the escalations with old -> new severity, and `Recommended: block <srcip> (response actions, C9, Phase 2); nothing was changed.`). Never suppresses, closes, merges or lowers anything; creates no case (D-N4 is N8N-5.1).
**Systems changed:** TheHive (this alert: alert, comments, observable tags and IOC flag, its tags and an escalation's severity raise; related ssh-bruteforce alerts: tag, severity raise, escalation comment) and the Wazuh indexer (asox-metrics documents, C11); Cortex and MISP run read-only lookups.
**Approval:** not needed: SOC bookkeeping only (TheHive tags, comments, severity raise; asox-metrics), no system changes.
**Owner:** n8n.
Result: pb-generic's (`outcome`, `metrics`, `enrichment`, ...) plus `correlation` (status, srcip, related, escalated). Error workflow: recv-n8n-error. The response itself (blocking the address) waits for C9 (Phase 2).
